div.head: Leis Wl 11.1
div.ab: Del poucer lui rendra la meité de la main. Del dei aprés le poucer, XV sol. de sol. Engleis que est apelé quaer denier. Del lung dei, XVI sol. De l'autre ki porte l'anel, XVII sol. Del petit dei, V sol.

For the thumb he shall pay him half the value of his hand; for the finger next the thumb 15 shillings according to the English reckoning, that is 4 pence to the shilling; for the middle finger 16 shillings; for the ring-finger 17 shillings; for the little finger 5 shillings.
